issues.description: Animal.getName() and Animal.setName(): the problem statement (Part 1 note) explicitly requires the name getter and setter to have protected visibility, but the reference solution declares both methods as public. This contradicts the exercise instructions and can confuse students about the intended encapsulation/visibility for the Animal API.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the mismatch between the problem statement and the reference solution. Preferred: change the reference solution signatures to protected (protected String getName() and protected void setName(String newName)) so subclasses retain access while external code cannot call them. Ensure any call sites in the solution or tests that rely on public access are updated accordingly. Alternatively, if public access is intended, update the problem statement to remove the "protected" requirement so instructions and solution align.
